description: Wake the session when a delegated task finishes, and clean up after workers that did not survive.

hooks.rewakeMessage: A delegated task finished. Use the task_id and task_dir in the notification (pass the parent of task_dir as --task-root) to collect it exactly once, weigh the evidence, and carry on with what the user asked for.
